column1: # ui field batch 1: the widget primitives (62 fields).
# Widget: its own accessors name every member - getData/setData (a), isVisible/setVisible (b),
#   get/setX (c), Y (d), Width (e), Height (f) - and the only remaining int, g, is what the
#   constructor's setColor(-1) and every draw call's getColor() use -> color.
# Button: getStyle/setStyle (b), setLabel (c) and the ButtonState field toggled by handleInput (a).
# Checkbox: same shape, with checked (b) toggled in handleInput and the doubled frame index in draw
# ButtonStyle / CheckboxStyle: draw() reads a[state]/b[state] as the frame x/y and c/d as the widget
#   size (also used as the label's max width in the screens: getDialogButtonStyle().c).
# Label: font (a), align (b), text (c), maxWidth (d) from their accessors; halfScale (e) is the
#   constructor boolean that halves every advance and glyph offset in the draw path.
# ListBox: selectedIndex (a), items (b), listener (c), previousButton/nextButton (e/f, data 0 and 1,
#   enabled by index bounds) and label (g); d is the "just changed" flag the arrow buttons set and
#   handleInput turns into one onAction call.
# NinePatch: NinePatchImage.draw walks the eight values as four column and four row coordinates -
#   (e..h) - which the nine batched draws reuse tile by tile.
#   where textureRegion.c/d are passed to setWidth/setHeight), Container.children (a, addChild/
# ScrollPane: state (a), style (b), content (c), clipRect (d), lastInputTime (e, the nanoTime base of
#   the frame delta), dragStartY (f), the 16-slot input history (h = timestamps, i = y positions)
#   walked backwards from historyIndex (g) to compute the fling velocity (k), dragStartContentY (j),
#   dragRegion (l: -1 when the press landed on the scroll bar, otherwise the content) and flinging
#   (m), which keeps integrating the velocity after the release until it drops below 2.64 px/s.
